current_schema_issue: A scalar NPR does not encode numerator/denominator pressure roles, pressure type, spatial state, and transient history.
why_it_matters: Unsafe comparison of storage, injector-internal, sonic-inlet and stagnation pressures.
proposed_change: Represent NPR as a contextual record with numerator/denominator role, absolute/gauge flag, location and time basis.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.

current_schema_issue: Distance and time fields do not formally distinguish formation, growth, maximum excursion, instantaneous and stabilized states.
why_it_matters: One value can silently mix different physical stages.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.

current_schema_issue: Current scalar fields cannot store p_inj(t) or a pressure-history identifier.
why_it_matters: Starting-jet dynamics depend on the build history even at the same final pressure.
proposed_change: Add time-series/reference object support and pressure_history_id.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.

current_schema_issue: Generic Mach lacks explicit incident-shock, post-shock freestream, local gas and droplet-relative contexts.
why_it_matters: C014 M∞ and C016 M_s are not comparable scalars.
proposed_change: Require mach_context and reference frame for every Mach record.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.

current_schema_issue: Reference velocity/density/length are optional and weakly linked to We.
why_it_matters: Equal numeric We can represent different loading definitions.
proposed_change: Make We velocity, density, length and surface-tension references mandatory linked fields.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.

current_schema_issue: No structured way to store Stage I/II with support type and uncertainty.
why_it_matters: Direct wave imaging and author instability interpretation must remain separated.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.

current_schema_issue: Single loading_duration conflates front passage, pressure pulse, shocked-state exposure, expansion-wave termination and total forcing.
why_it_matters: Droplet response depends on which interval is meant.
proposed_change: Split loading intervals and require start/end event definitions.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.

current_schema_issue: Model coefficients and physical/material properties share the same broad phase-change group.
why_it_matters: Calibrated inputs must not be mistaken for measured fluid properties.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.

current_schema_issue: No dedicated sign-convention field for evaporation/condensation mass flux.
why_it_matters: Positive/negative interpretation can reverse between papers.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.

current_schema_issue: Breakup and phase-change records lack a coupling/sequence relation.
why_it_matters: Concurrent feedback cannot be reconstructed from independent scalar rows.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.

current_schema_issue: Model validity context does not encode steady versus variable post-front acceleration.
why_it_matters: Canonical shock models overpredict extinction rate in the detonation comparison.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.

current_schema_issue: Injection/ignition events are stored as isolated values without event relationships.
why_it_matters: ΔSOI, SOI-to-overlap, pilot ignition, main ignition and EOI need explicit direction and reference event.
proposed_change: Add event_id, reference_event_id and signed interval semantics.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.

current_schema_issue: No dedicated interaction-angle/overlap field; relative momentum has no safe NR rationale field.
why_it_matters: Geometry is causal context and should not be hidden in notes.
proposed_change: Add interaction_angle, overlap_start_distance and momentum_ratio_definition fields.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.

current_schema_issue: Scalar parameters cannot directly express vortex → heat/radical transport → ignition consequence with evidence type.
why_it_matters: Simulation-resolved and interpreted links must be auditable.
proposed_change: Add linked mechanism-chain records with support_type per edge.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.

current_schema_issue: No native fields for evaporation distance L_E, detonation height L_D and their defined ratio.
why_it_matters: RDE stability criterion cannot be reconstructed safely.
proposed_change: Add named characteristic scales and ratio numerator/denominator references.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.

current_schema_issue: Free-text source_location does not separately encode PDF page, printed page, section, figure, table and equation.
why_it_matters: Citation audits and automated validation remain fragile.
proposed_change: Add structured locator components while retaining a human-readable locator.
notes: No formal schema file modified in Phase 6 Pilot.
